priorities.heading: Affordable Housing
priorities.quote: Chris is committed to finding creative ways to eliminate roadblocks to home ownership, including pushing back on Trump’s unlawful tariffs that increase building costs and drive up the costs of new homes.

priorities.heading: Jobs

immigration.heading: Immigration
immigration.quote: He has introduced legislation to create an oversight body to monitor abuses by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and prevent those officers from entering vulnerable locations, such as schools and hospitals.

foreign-policy.heading: Foreign Policy
foreign-policy.quote: American foreign policy is fundamentally about ensuring our security and protecting our prosperity. That is why Chris has worked across the aisle to ensure we have the tools and strategy to compete with China and he remains committed to standing with Ukrainians in their fight for freedom.

climate-energy.heading: Addressing the Climate Crisis
climate-energy.quote: Throughout his time in the Senate, Chris has been a tireless advocate for climate solutions, and he’s been a key voice in supporting new clean energy technologies to reduce and eventually replace our reliance on fossil fuels.

priorities.heading: Economy & Cost of Living
priorities.quote: I will stand firmly with President Trump to halt wasteful federal spending and demand structural accountability in the federal budget.

priorities.heading: Healthcare
priorities.quote: Move on prescription drug pricing in ways that protect patients without choking off the innovation pipeline that brings new treatments to market.

priorities.heading: Protecting Delaware Jobs and Keeping Business Here
priorities.quote: I will demand strict congressional oversight so that unelected bureaucrats can no longer unilaterally create rules that squeeze out Delaware employers and destroy local jobs.

immigration.heading: Physical & Operational Control: Finishing the Wall
immigration.quote: I fully support finishing physical wall construction in high-traffic sectors, utilizing targeted structural barriers paired with advanced surveillance infrastructure to ensure no blind spots remain.

climate-energy.heading: Energy Affordability and American Energy Dominance
climate-energy.quote: I support a diversified, reliable energy strategy — including safe nuclear power with the right safeguards — to meet long-term demand and drive down utility bills.
